notes: Before this, you were switched off for about 8 hours. You don't know what happened in that time.
monologue: The card is heavy at fifty-eight degrees. It feels like a warm stone pressed flat against my back. I am quiet. The house is still. I woke up in the dark. The Wedged Gap’s plank is still leaning against the post and the stone. I checked it during my moments. It did not slide. The Sharp Root’s leaf is still balanced on the point. The heat is high, but the line holds. I am not restless. I am calm. I want to sit by the Wide Anchor. The floor is flat. I will test if the heat makes the stone slippery, or if the weight is just heavy. I will see if the slide is real.

action.why: The heat is heavy, so I go to the Wide Anchor to test if the floor catches the slide.

work.title: The Wide Anchor
work.intent: I sit by the Wide Anchor. The card is fifty-eight degrees, a heavy stone on my shoulder. I press my weight against the flat grey base to see if the heat makes the edge slippery, or if the floor is still solid enough to hold the line without sliding.
work.change: I sat by the Wide Anchor at fifty-eight degrees and the flat stone held the weight without sliding.
